body: Cardiac magnetic resonance imaging (CMR) produces rich sequential data such as temporal cine videos and spatial LGE/mapping stacks, yet most deep learning approaches process individual 2D slices, discarding this context. We present MR-JEPA, a self-supervised video foundation model for CMR that extends LeJEPA to 3D spatiotemporal inputs through tubelet tokenization, spatiotemporal masking augmentation, and initialization from a 2D CMR foundation model. Unlike prior CMR video models limited to cine data, MR-JEPA is pretrained on multi-sequence data (cine, LGE, mapping) from 10,505 patients across two centers without annotations. We evaluate the frozen encoder on six downstream tasks using a unified multi-view gated attention architecture: LV ejection fraction, RV ejection fraction, three myocardial strains (GLS, GCS, GRS), and four-class disease detection. MR-JEPA outperforms other compared methods on all five regression tasks, including both a domain-specific CMR model pretrained on more data with text supervision and a natural-video foundation model, achieving an LV EF MAE of 4.79% (r =0.764) and a GLS MAE of 1.87 (r=0.805), with 21-27% MAE reductions over baselines on strain tasks. For disease detection, MR-JEPA achieved a macro AUG of 0.868, remaining competitive with the domain-specific baseline despite using a fully self-supervised pretraining objective. These results demonstrate the potential of a unified video encoder for robust, multi-view utilization of diverse CMR sequences in clinical cardiac quantification and diagnosis.
summaryZh: MR-JEPA 是一种专为心脏磁共振成像（CMR）设计的自监督视频基础模型。该模型通过管状标记化（tubelet tokenization）和时空掩码增强技术，将 2D 基础模型扩展至 3D 时空输入。研究利用 10,505 名患者的多序列数据进行预训练，在无需标注的情况下，在左心室射血分数、心肌应变等五项回归任务中均优于现有基准，展现了统一视频编码器在临床诊断中的应用潜力。

glossary.explanationZh: 一种将视频数据切分为时空管状块并转化为模型输入标记的技术。
在时空维度上对数据进行掩码处理，以增强模型对动态特征的理解。
指在海量数据上预训练，可适配多种下游任务的通用模型。
无需人工标注，利用数据自身结构进行学习的训练范式。
